# Style rotation — report

**Slug:** `family-style-rotation`  
**Dev:** 31.33% CAGR / 69.89% DD / 0.79 Sharpe, 285 fills.  
**Full:** 37.98% CAGR / 69.89% DD / 0.92 Sharpe, 341 fills.  

IWF/IWD 40-session relative momentum: growth leadership -> TQQQ; value
leadership -> BIL. The full holdout clears the TQQQ CAGR bar (37.98% vs
37.54%), but drawdown is 69.9%. The result is a style signal, not an existing
price-trend or calendar gate.
hypothesis_md:
# Growth/value style rotation

**Slug:** `family-style-rotation`  
**Family:** style-rotation  
**Primary object:** IWF/IWD growth-vs-value relative momentum.

When growth (IWF) leads value (IWD) over 40 sessions, hold TQQQ; when value
leads, hold BIL. Signal at session close; fill next QQQ/TQQQ open. Long-only,
2% band, 1 bp headline. No trend/vol/calendar/opening-range/ML gate.
